name: code-studio-pro
description: Build websites & mobile apps in your browser. PWA + Android + iOS.

scripts.build:android: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android-release: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:aab: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:ios: npx cap sync ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -scheme App -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 14'
